description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456): `${…}` in a URL-valued attribute whose literal value begins with a non-safe scheme (`JaVaScRiPt:` on `href`, `javascript:` on `action`, `data:` on iframe `src`) is refused.
rationale: §5.2 executable-sink rule: interpolation into a URL-valued attribute whose literal text begins with a scheme other than `http:`, `https:`, `mailto:` or `tel:` SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE); the scheme is compared case-insensitively. Before S456 each compiled to `setAttribute(<attr>, `javascript:go('${…}')`)`.
